observations: Three photos show a black, rectangular device with a circular lens on one end and a textured side with a grid pattern.
The device has a small circular logo on the side, resembling the Xbox logo.
A black cable with a USB connector is coiled and tied with a green rubber band.
The device is placed on a white surface with a watermark 'McSteve POSTED ON JIJI' and contact details.
The device appears to be in used condition with visible smudges and minor scratches on the surface.
No power adapter, mounting bracket, or other accessories are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: This is a Neatly used Microsoft Xbox One Motion Sensing Kinetic Camera And it Works with Xbox One
claims.evidence: The device matches the appearance of an Xbox One Kinect camera, but there is no visual proof of functionality. No video or demonstration is provided.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera connected to a Xbox One and successfully detecting motion or displaying a live feed.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as power adapter, mounting bracket, or cables may be present but not shown.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out together.

risks.risk: The device may have been damaged during storage or handling, such as internal cracks or loose components.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the device's underside and connectors, showing no damage or loose parts.

proof_requests: Video of the camera working with a Xbox One console.
Photo showing all included accessories (power adapter, cables, etc.).
Close-up photo of the device's connectors and underside for damage inspection.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
